description: This file initializes and renders the root React component into the DOM, serving as the entry point for a React application.

methods.name: createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering, attached to the DOM element with id 'root'.

parameters.name: document.getElementById('root')
parameters.description: The DOM element where the React app will be mounted.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React application wrapped in StrictMode into the root.
